column1: PART 1: PROBLEM DEFINITION (Challenges Faced by Indian Farmers)

column3: Traditional flood irrigation wastes 30% to 40% of fresh groundwater due to evaporation and uncontrolled field flooding because farmers lack visual root-zone moisture data.
column4: Groundwater depletion across agricultural basins; higher pumping electricity costs.

column3: Crop diseases (Paddy Blast, Tomato Blight, Root Wilt) are diagnosed after visible damage spreads. Farmers rely on indiscriminate chemical sprays that degrade soil and enter food supply.
column4: Annual crop losses of 20-30%; toxic chemical runoff into freshwater streams; high pesticide debt.

column3: Farmers lack direct access to wholesale buyers and live APMC mandi pricing, forcing them to sell through multiple commission agents at low prices.
column4: Farmers receive 20% to 35% below fair market value; economic distress in farming households.

column3: Existing smart agriculture apps are in English, cluttered with complex text and forms, and require typing, making them inaccessible to rural farmers.
column4: High barrier to technological adoption; smallholder farmers are left behind in the digital transition.

column1: PART 2: PROJECT IDEATION & SOLUTION (How AGRI VISION 3D Solves It)

column3: Interactive Three.js 3D representation of farmer plots showing topsoil, root depth, and 5 dynamic layers: Crop growth, Soil moisture, Irrigation lines, Health index, and Soil type.
column4: Visual clarity for farmers without complex graphs; precise plot monitoring.

column3: Mobile camera leaf photo diagnosis using AI agronomy. Suggests TNAU-verified organic remedies (Panchagavya, Pseudomonas fluorescens) before chemical IPM.
column4: Restores soil microbiome; eliminates toxic chemical runoff; cuts pesticide costs by 40%.

column3: Converts crop evapotranspiration (mm/day) and root-zone sensor moisture into exact daily liter requirements with scheduled drip runtimes.
column4: Conserves up to 30-40% irrigation water; prevents root rot and fertilizer leaching.

column3: Commission-free marketplace with live Tamil Nadu APMC Mandi price tickers, allowing farmers to post harvest listings and connect directly with verified buyers via Call / WhatsApp.
column4: Eliminates middlemen cuts; increases farmer net profit by 20-30%.

column3: Native Tamil interface with built-in voice navigation and text-to-speech audio explanations so illiterate farmers can speak queries and listen to guidance.
column4: Ensures 100% inclusivity for rural farmers across varying literacy levels.
